en.t: Pompey disembarks at Pelusium upon arriving in Egypt, whereupon he is assassinated by order of King Ptolemy XIII
en.s: Gnaeus Pompeius Magnus (Latin: [ˈŋnae̯.ʊs pomˈpejʊs ˈmaŋnʊs]; 29 September 106 BC – 28 September 48 BC), known in English as Pompey ( POM-pee) or Pompey the Great, was a Roman general and statesman who was prominent in the final decades of the Roman Republic. As a young man, he was a partisan and protégé of the dictator Sulla, after whose death he achieved significant military and political success.

zh.t: 庞培抵达埃及，在佩卢西乌姆登陆后奉托勒密十三世之命遇刺
zh.s: 格奈乌斯·庞培（拉丁语：Gnaeus Pompeius Magnus；公元前106年9月29日—公元前48年9月28日），英文常称庞培或庞培大帝，是罗马共和国末期的重要将领和政治家。年轻时，他是独裁者苏拉的支持者和门生；苏拉去世后，庞培在军事和政治上取得显著成就。

en.t: Pope Pontian resigns. He is exiled to the mines of Sardinia, along with Hippolytus of Rome
en.s: Pope Pontian (Latin: Pontianus; died October 235) was the bishop of Rome from 21 July 230 to 28 September 235. In 235, during the persecution of Christians in the reign of the Emperor Maximinus Thrax, Pontian was arrested and sent to the island of Sardinia. He abdicated to make the election of a new pope possible. Resigning on 28 September 235, he was the first pope to do so.

zh.t: 教宗庞提安退位并被流放
zh.s: 教宗庞提安于230年7月21日至235年9月28日担任罗马主教。235年，在马克西米努斯·色雷克斯皇帝统治期间迫害基督徒的背景下，庞提安被捕并流放到撒丁岛。他为使新教宗能够当选而退位，是历史上第一位退位的教宗。

en.s: The Battle of Mursa was fought on 28 September 351 between the eastern Roman armies led by the Emperor Constantius II and the western forces supporting the usurper Magnentius. It took place at Mursa, near the Via Militaris in the province of Pannonia (modern Osijek, Croatia). The battle, one of the bloodiest in Roman history, was a pyrrhic victory for Constantius.

zh.s: 穆尔萨战役于351年9月28日爆发，交战双方是君士坦提乌斯二世率领的东罗马军队，以及支持篡位者马格嫩提乌斯的西部军队。战场位于潘诺尼亚行省的穆尔萨，靠近军事大道，今为克罗地亚奥西耶克一带。这是罗马史上最血腥的战役之一，君士坦提乌斯虽获胜，也付出了惨重代价。

en.s: The siege of Baghdad Arabic: حِصَارُ بَغْدَاد, romanized: Ḥiṣāru Baghdād was a part of a civil war between al-Amin and al-Ma'mun for the Abbasid Caliphate of Baghdad. The siege lasted from August 812 until September 813. The siege is described by Muhammad ibn Jarir al-Tabari in his History of the Prophets and Kings.

zh.s: 巴格达围城战是阿拔斯王朝内战的一部分，交战双方为哈里发穆罕默德·阿明和阿卜杜拉·马蒙。围城从812年8月持续到813年9月。穆罕默德·本·贾里尔·塔巴里在《历代先知与帝王史》中记述了这场围城。

en.s: The Battle of Tinchebray (alternate spellings Tinchebrai or Tenchebrai) was fought 28 September 1106, in Tinchebray (today in Orne département of France), Normandy, between an invading force led by King Henry I of England, and his older brother Robert Curthose, the Duke of Normandy. Henry's knights won a decisive victory, capturing Robert and imprisoning him in England (in Devizes Castle) and then Wales until Robert's death (in Cardiff Castle). Henry invaded Normandy in 1105, taking Bayeux and Caen. He broke off his campaign because of political problems arising from the Investiture Controversy. With these settled, he returned to Normandy in the spring of 1106.

zh.s: 坦什布赖战役又有Tinchebrai或Tenchebrai等拼法，于1106年9月28日在诺曼底的坦什布赖（今法国奥恩省）爆发。交战双方是英格兰国王亨利一世率领的入侵军队，以及他的哥哥、诺曼底公爵罗贝尔·柯索斯。亨利的骑士取得决定性胜利，俘获罗贝尔，并将他囚禁在英格兰的德维兹城堡，后来又押往威尔士；罗贝尔最终在卡迪夫城堡去世。亨利于1105年入侵诺曼底，占领巴约和卡昂，但因叙任权斗争引发的政治问题中止战事。问题解决后，他于1106年春天重返诺曼底。

en.s: Gertrude of Merania, the queen consort of Hungary as the first wife of King Andrew II (r. 1205–1235), was assassinated by a group of Hungarian lords on 28 September 1213 in the Pilis Mountains during a royal hunting expedition. Leopold VI, Duke of Austria and Gertrude's brother Berthold, Archbishop of Kalocsa were also wounded but survived the attack.

zh.t: 梅拉尼亚的格特鲁德遇刺
zh.s: 1213年9月28日，匈牙利王后梅拉尼亚的格特鲁德在皮利什山脉参加王室狩猎时，被一群匈牙利贵族刺杀。她是安德拉什二世的第一任妻子。奥地利公爵利奥波德六世和格特鲁德的兄弟、考洛乔大主教贝特霍尔德也在袭击中受伤，但幸存下来。

en.t: King James I of Aragon conquers Valencia from the Moors. Shortly thereafter, he proclaims himself king of Valencia
en.s: James I the Conqueror (Catalan: Jaume I or Jaume el Conqueridor; Aragonese: Chaime I o Conqueridor; 2 February 1208 – 27 July 1276) was the 11th King of Aragon, 38th Count of Barcelona, and Lord of Montpellier from 1213 to 1276; King of Majorca from 1231 to 1276; and King of Valencia from 1238 to 1276.

zh.t: 阿拉贡国王海梅一世从摩尔人手中征服瓦伦西亚，不久后自称瓦伦西亚国王
zh.s: 1229年12月31日，阿拉贡国王征服者海梅一世进入马略卡岛的麦地那·马尤尔卡（今帕尔马），完成基督教势力对马略卡岛的收复。

en.s: The Battle of Mühldorf (also known as the Battle of Ampfing) was fought near Mühldorf am Inn on September 28, 1322 between the Duchy of (Upper) Bavaria and the Archduchy of Austria. The Bavarians were led by German King Louis of Wittelsbach, while the Austrians were under the command of his cousin, Anti-king Frederick of Habsburg.

zh.s: 米尔多夫战役也称安普芬战役，于1322年9月28日在米尔多夫附近爆发。交战双方是上巴伐利亚公国和奥地利大公国。巴伐利亚军队由维特尔斯巴赫的德国国王路易率领，奥地利军队则由他的表亲、对立国王哈布斯堡的腓特烈指挥。

en.s: English offensives in 1345–1347, during the Hundred Years' War, resulted in repeated defeats of the French, the loss or devastation of much French territory and the capture by the English of the port of Calais. The war had broken out in 1337 and flared up in 1340 when the king of England, Edward III, laid claim to the French crown and campaigned in northern France.

zh.s: 百年战争期间，英军于1345年至1347年发动攻势，多次击败法军，夺取或摧毁法国大片领土，并攻下加莱港。战争始于1337年，1340年英格兰国王爱德华三世宣称拥有法国王位并入侵法国北部后，战事再次升级。

en.s: The Battle of Tripoli was a military engagement between the Crusaders of Cyprus and the Mamluk garrison of Tripoli, Lebanon. The Crusaders were initially victorious, entering the city and sacking it. However, the Mamluks repelled the attack, ending the raid in a fiasco.

zh.s: 1367年，塞浦路斯十字军与黎巴嫩的黎波里马穆鲁克守军交战。十字军起初占了上风，攻入城内并洗劫城市，但马穆鲁克军队随后击退了进攻，这次袭击以惨败告终。

en.s: The siege of Malbork took place between September 28, 1457 and August 5, 1460, during the Thirteen Years' War. The Teutonic Knights tried to regain the fortress (Ordensburg) of Malbork (or Marienburg), which had been the capital of their state, but was captured by the Kingdom of Poland in June 1457. The Knights, commanded by Bernard Szumborski, failed to do so, and Malbork remained in Polish hands, becoming the seat of Malbork Voivodeship.

zh.s: 十三年战争期间，波兰军队于1457年6月攻占马尔堡要塞。条顿骑士团随后试图夺回这座曾是其国家首都的城堡。1457年9月28日至1460年8月5日，骑士团在伯恩哈德·舒姆博尔斯基率领下围攻马尔堡，但未能成功。马尔堡继续由波兰控制，并成为马尔堡省的行政中心。

en.s: The Battle of Rotebro was fought on 28 September 1497 between the armies of John, King of Denmark and Sten Sture the Elder, the deposed regent of Sweden. Sten Sture had fallen out of favor with the nobility and was deposed on March 1497 of his post as Regent of Sweden. The Danes invaded Sweden in July of that year, and defeated Sten's peasant army on 28 September at the village of Rotebro north of Stockholm.

zh.s: 罗特布罗战役于1497年9月28日爆发，交战双方是丹麦国王约翰的军队与被废黜的瑞典摄政斯滕·斯图雷。斯滕·斯图雷于1497年3月失去贵族支持，被免去摄政职务。同年7月，丹麦军队入侵瑞典，并于9月28日在斯德哥尔摩以北的罗特布罗村击败斯滕的农民军。

en.s: The Battle of Preveza (also known as Prevesa) was a naval engagement that occurred on 28 September 1538 near Preveza in the Ionian Sea in northwest Greece, in the same area as the Battle of Actium in 31 BC. The battle was between an Ottoman fleet, led by Kapudan Pasha Hayreddin Barbarossa, and a Holy League of Venetian and Hispano-Imperial composition, led by Genoese admiral Andrea Doria.

zh.s: 普雷韦扎海战也称普雷韦萨海战，于1538年9月28日在希腊西北部爱奥尼亚海的普雷韦扎附近爆发，地点与公元前31年的亚克兴海战相近。交战双方是海雷丁·巴巴罗萨率领的奥斯曼舰队，以及由热那亚海军上将安德烈亚·多里亚指挥的神圣同盟舰队；同盟由威尼斯和西班牙-神圣罗马帝国势力组成。

en.s: The surprise of Meaux (La surprise de Meaux) was a failed coup attempt by leading aristocratic Huguenots which precipitated the second French War of Religion. Dissatisfied with their lot, and under the pretext of fear of extermination, Louis, Prince of Condé and Gaspard II de Coligny plotted to seize the king, Charles IX, while he was staying near Meaux.

zh.s: 莫城突袭事件是法国宗教战争第二次战争爆发的导火索，是胡格诺派贵族试图发动的一场失败政变。孔代亲王路易和加斯帕尔二世·德科利尼以担心遭到灭绝为由，策划在查理九世停留在莫城附近时将其挟持。

en.s: The Uprising against Erik XIV (Swedish: Upproret mot Erik XIV), also called the Duke's uprising (Swedish: Hertigarnas resning), was the successful uprising against the Swedish king Erik XIV in 1568 by his brothers Duke John and Duke Charles (later John III and Charles IX) that resulted in Erik's deposition.

The rebel leader was Stephen Bocskai, a Protestant Hungarian nobleman.

en.s: The Koshlakov Raid was an assault on the town of Koshlakov by Chechen highlanders from the Shatoy tribe, resulting in a victory for the raiders.

en.s: The action of 28 September 1644 was a naval battle which was fought in the Eastern Mediterranean when six Hospitaller galleys under Gabriel de Chambres Boisbaudran attacked a convoy of ten Ottoman sailing ships including a galleon commanded by Ibrahim Çelebi. Both sides suffered considerable casualties including the deaths of both commanders, and the battle ended when the Hospitallers captured the richly-laden galleon after hours of fighting.

zh.s: 1644年9月28日，东地中海发生海战。加布里埃尔·德·尚布尔·布瓦博德朗率领六艘医院骑士团桨帆船，袭击一支由十艘奥斯曼帆船组成的船队，其中包括易卜拉欣·切莱比指挥的一艘大帆船。双方伤亡惨重，两名指挥官都阵亡。经过数小时战斗，医院骑士团夺下了满载货物的大帆船，战斗结束。

en.s: The Battle of the Kentish Knock (or the Battle of the Zealand Approaches) was a naval battle between the fleets of the Dutch Republic and England, fought on 28 September 1652 (8 October Gregorian calendar), during the First Anglo-Dutch War near the shoal called the Kentish Knock in the North Sea about thirty kilometres east of the mouth of the river Thames.

zh.s: 肯蒂什诺克海战也称泽兰进路海战，是第一次英荷战争期间荷兰共和国与英格兰舰队之间的一场海战。战斗于1652年9月28日（格里历10月8日）在北海肯蒂什诺克浅滩附近爆发，地点距泰晤士河口以东约30公里。

en.s: The siege of Mouzon was fought in eastern France during the Franco-Spanish War in 1653 a battle at the siege of the fortress of Mouzon. The battle took place shortly after Viscount Turenne launched a mobile defence against the invading Spanish army, which was facing Rocroi. The town was besieged.

zh.s: 穆宗围城战是1653年法西战争期间在法国东部穆宗要塞发生的战斗。图雷纳子爵刚对正逼近罗克鲁瓦的西班牙入侵军发动机动作战防御，随后穆宗镇遭到围攻。

en.s: The Battle of Bloody Brook was fought on September 28, 1675 (September 18, 1675 OS) between an indigenous war party primarily composed of Pocumtuc warriors and other local indigenous people from the central Connecticut River valley, and the English colonial militia of the New England Confederation and their Mohegan allies during King Philip's War.

zh.s: 血溪战役发生于1675年9月28日（旧历9月18日），交战双方是以波库姆塔克战士为主、并有康涅狄格河谷中部其他当地原住民参加的武装队伍，以及新英格兰邦联的英格兰殖民地民兵和莫希干盟军。战斗发生在菲利普王战争期间。

en.s: The Battle of Wijnendale took place during the War of the Spanish Succession fought on 28 September 1708 near Wijnendale, Flanders, between an allied force protecting a convoy carrying ammunition for the Siege of Lille (1708) and forces of Bourbon France and Spain. It ended in a victory for the allies, leading to the taking of Lille.

zh.s: 维恩代尔战役发生于西班牙王位继承战争期间。1708年9月28日，盟军在佛兰德斯的维恩代尔附近护送一支运送弹药、支援围攻里尔的车队，途中遭到法西波旁军队袭击。盟军获胜，随后攻占了里尔。

en.s: The Battle of Kvareli (Georgian: ყვარლის ბრძოლა) took place between the Kingdoms of Kartli and Kakheti and the Avar Khanate as well as its tributaries in 1755. Nursal-Bey, leading a Dagestani and Jar-Balakan army, laid siege to the castle at Kvareli.

zh.s: 1755年，卡尔特利王国和卡赫季王国与阿瓦尔汗国及其附属势力交战。努尔萨尔贝伊率领达吉斯坦和贾尔-巴拉坎军队围攻克瓦雷利城堡。

en.s: The Battle of Fehrbellin was a battle at Fehrbellin of the Seven Years' War between Swedish and Prussian forces fought on 28 September 1758. The Prussian forces under General Carl Heinrich von Wedel were attempting to stop the Swedish offensive into Brandenburg. The Swedish forces held the town, with one gun at each of the three gates. The Prussians arrived first and managed to break through at the western (Mühlenthor) gate, driving the outnumbered Swedes in disarray through the streets. However, reinforcements arrived, and the Prussians, who had failed to burn the bridge, were forced to retreat.

zh.s: 费尔贝林战役是七年战争期间瑞典与普鲁士军队在费尔贝林发生的一场战斗，于1758年9月28日进行。卡尔·海因里希·冯·韦德尔将军率领普军阻止瑞典军队攻入勃兰登堡。瑞典军占据城镇，在三座城门各部署一门炮。普军先抵达，并从西侧的磨坊门突破，迫使人数较少的瑞典军队混乱地退入街道。随后援军赶到；普军因未能烧毁桥梁，被迫撤退。

en.t: American Revolution: Samuel Huntington is elected President of the Continental Congress, succeeding John Jay
en.s: The American Revolution (1765–1789) was a political movement in the Thirteen Colonies of Great Britain. It began as a rebellion and turned into a revolution eventually creating the sovereign United States, which was the outcome of the associated American Revolutionary War (1775–1783). The Second Continental Congress, as the provisional government, established the Continental Army and appointed George Washington as its commander-in-chief in 1775.

zh.t: 美国独立战争：塞缪尔·亨廷顿当选大陆会议主席，接替约翰·杰伊
zh.s: 美国独立运动（1765—1789）是大不列颠在北美十三殖民地发生的一场政治运动。它起初是反抗行动，后来演变为革命，最终建立主权独立的美国；美国独立战争（1775—1783）是这一运动的结果。临时政府第二次大陆会议于1775年组建大陆军，并任命乔治·华盛顿为总司令。

en.s: The Siege of Yorktown, also known as the Battle of Yorktown and the surrender at Yorktown, took place in 1781 and was the final major land engagement of the American Revolutionary War. It was won decisively by the Continental Army, led by George Washington, with support from the Marquis de Lafayette and French Army troops, led by Comte de Rochambeau, and a French Navy force commanded by the Comte de Grasse, defeating the British Army commanded by British Lieutenant General Charles Cornwallis.

zh.s: 约克镇围城战又称约克镇战役或约克镇受降，发生于1781年，是美国独立战争中最后一场重大地面交战。乔治·华盛顿率领的大陆军，在拉法耶特侯爵、罗尚博伯爵指挥的法国陆军，以及德格拉斯伯爵指挥的法国海军支援下，决定性地击败了英国中将查尔斯·康沃利斯指挥的英军。

en.s: The Capture of Nice occurred on September 28, 1792, during the French Revolutionary Wars between the First French Republic and Kingdom of Sardinia. Part of the Italian Campaign during the French Revolution, the French were led by General Jacques Bernard d'Anselme who was tasked to occupy the County of Nice. The county was captured without a fight.

zh.s: 法国大革命战争期间，法兰西第一共和国与萨丁尼亚王国交战，法国军队于1792年9月28日攻占尼斯。此次行动属于法国革命战争中的意大利战役。雅克·贝尔纳·丹塞尔姆将军奉命占领尼斯伯国，法军未遇抵抗便拿下该地。

en.s: The Battle of Méribel was fought on 28 September 1793 at the village of Méribel, near Sallanches in the modern French department of Haute-Savoie, during the War of the First Coalition. The forces of the Kingdom of Sardinia were defeated by the French Revolutionary Army.

zh.s: 第一次反法同盟战争期间，萨丁尼亚王国军队与法国革命军于1793年9月28日在梅里贝勒村交战。该村位于今法国上萨瓦省、萨朗什附近。萨丁尼亚军队战败。

en.s: The Helsinki village landing, or the Combat of Helsinge (Russian: Бой у Гельсинге), was fought during the Finnish War between Sweden and the Russian Empire on 26–28 September [O.S. 14–16 September] 1808, a part of the battles of the Turku archipelago.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

en.s: The capture of Alhóndiga de Granaditas was a military action carried out in Guanajuato, viceroyalty of New Spain, on September 28, 1810, between the royalist soldiers of the province and the insurgents commanded by Miguel Hidalgo and Ignacio Allende. The fear unleashed in the social circles of the provincial capital made the intendant, Juan Antonio Riaño, ask the population to barrack in the Alhóndiga de Granaditas, a granary built in 1800, and in whose construction Miguel Hidalgo had participated as an advisor to his old friend Riaño.

zh.t: 攻占格拉纳迪塔斯粮仓
zh.s: 1810年9月28日，西班牙新西班牙总督辖区瓜纳华托发生军事行动。该省保王军与米格尔·伊达尔戈、伊格纳西奥·阿连德率领的起义军交战。省会的上层社会陷入恐慌，总督胡安·安东尼奥·里亚尼奥要求居民躲进格拉纳迪塔斯粮仓。这座粮仓建于1800年，伊达尔戈曾以顾问身份参与建造，当时他与里亚尼奥还是老朋友。

en.s: The raid at Altenburg on 28 September 1813 took place during the War of the Sixth Coalition's Allied autumn campaign in Saxony. The raid was carried out by the Streifkorp under the command of Saxon General Johann von Thielmann commanding seven regiments of Cossacks, a squadron each of Saxon Hussars and Dragoons, and a detachment of Saxon Freikorps numbering about 1,500 cavalry.

zh.s: 阿尔滕堡突袭战发生于1813年9月28日，是第六次反法同盟战争期间盟军在萨克森秋季战役中的一场战斗。萨克森将军约翰·冯·蒂尔曼率领“游击骑兵队”发起突袭，部队包括七个哥萨克团、各一个萨克森骠骑兵和龙骑兵中队，以及一支约有1500名骑兵的萨克森自由军分队。

en.s: The Declaration of Independence of the Mexican Empire (Spanish: Acta de Independencia del Imperio Mexicano) is the document by which Mexico declared independence from the Spanish Empire. This founding document of the Mexican nation was drafted in the National Palace in Mexico City on 28 September 1821, by Juan José Espinosa de los Monteros, secretary of the Provisional Governmental Board. Three copies of the act were executed.

zh.s: 《墨西哥帝国独立宣言》（西班牙语：Acta de Independencia del Imperio Mexicano）是墨西哥宣布脱离西班牙帝国独立的文件，也是墨西哥建国的重要文书。1821年9月28日，临时执政委员会秘书胡安·何塞·埃斯皮诺萨·德洛斯蒙特罗斯在墨西哥城国家宫起草了这份文件，并制作了三份副本。

en.t: Oscar I of Sweden–Norway is crowned king of Sweden
en.s: Oscar I (born Joseph François Oscar Bernadotte; 4 July 1799 – 8 July 1859) was King of Sweden and Norway from 8 March 1844 until his death. He was the second monarch of the House of Bernadotte. The only child of King Charles XIV John, Oscar inherited the thrones upon the death of his father.

zh.t: 瑞典—挪威国王奥斯卡一世加冕为瑞典国王
zh.s: 奥斯卡一世（本名约瑟夫·弗朗索瓦·奥斯卡·贝尔纳多特；1799年7月4日—1859年7月8日）自1844年3月8日起担任瑞典和挪威国王，直至去世。他是贝尔纳多特王朝的第二位君主，也是查理十四世·约翰国王的独子；父亲去世后，他继承了王位。

en.s: The Brownsville Raid was the opening act of the Cortina Troubles, a series of raids by Mexican rancher Juan Cortina into Texas. The raid was precipitated by Brownsville sheriff Robert Shears attacking a Mexican man named Thomas Cabrera and in turn being shot by Cortina. The incident was a culmination of growing discontent between Mexicans and Texan settlers.

zh.s: 布朗斯维尔突袭战拉开了科尔蒂纳骚乱的序幕。骚乱期间，墨西哥牧场主胡安·科尔蒂纳多次袭击得克萨斯州。此前，布朗斯维尔警长罗伯特·希尔斯袭击了名叫托马斯·卡布雷拉的墨西哥人，随后被科尔蒂纳开枪打伤。这起事件也反映了墨西哥移民与得克萨斯定居者之间日益加深的不满。

en.s: The Battle of Vernon, Florida was a minor skirmish of the American Civil War that took place on 28 September 1864, near the town of Vernon, Florida. Coming a day after the larger Battle of Marianna, this conflict involved a company of Home Guard troops from Vernon who were going to the aid of their Confederate compatriots in that city. Unbeknownst to the Southerners, their route had taken them straight toward the withdrawing Federal column under Brigadier General Alexander Asboth, which was returning to their main base at Pensacola after their victory at Marianna.

zh.s: 弗农战役是美国内战期间一场小规模冲突，于1864年9月28日在佛罗里达州弗农附近发生，距离前一天规模更大的玛丽安娜战役仅一天。来自弗农的一支地方守备队前往增援玛丽安娜的邦联同伴，却不知自己的行军路线正好迎面撞上亚历山大·阿斯博思准将率领的联邦军纵队。联邦军在玛丽安娜战役取胜后，正撤回彭萨科拉的主基地。

en.s: The International Workingmen's Association (IWA), commonly known as the First International, was a political international which aimed to unite a variety of left-wing political groups and trade union organizations based on the working class and class struggle. It was founded in 1864 at a workers' meeting in St Martin's Hall, London, and its first congress was held in 1866 in Geneva.

zh.s: 国际工人协会（IWA）通常称为第一国际，是一个旨在团结各类左翼政治团体和工会组织的国际组织，主张以工人阶级和阶级斗争为基础。组织于1864年在伦敦圣马丁堂的一次工人集会上成立，1866年在日内瓦召开第一次代表大会。

en.s: The Battle of Infernal Caverns was a battle during the Snake War fought between Native Americans and the U.S. Army. The Native American warriors had made a fortress out of lava rocks in the Infernal Caverns of northern California near the town of Likely. From there they were able to pour a steady fire upon the soldiers commanded by Lt. Col. George Crook.

zh.s: 地狱洞穴战役是蛇战期间美国陆军与原住民之间的一场战斗。原住民战士在加利福尼亚州北部、利克利镇附近的地狱洞穴中用熔岩岩石筑起堡垒，并从中持续向乔治·克鲁克中校指挥的美军开火。

en.s: The Battle of Alcolea took place on 28 September 1868, over a bridge above Guadalquivir river in the town of Alcolea, Córdoba, Spain. In this battle, revolutionary forces led by General Francisco Serrano y Domínguez defeated Queen Isabella II of Spain´s governmental forces commanded by general Manuel Pavía, forcing Isabella II of Spain to leave Spain and be exiled in France.

zh.s: 阿尔科莱亚战役于1868年9月28日在西班牙科尔多瓦省阿尔科莱亚镇的一座瓜达尔基维尔河桥上爆发。弗朗西斯科·塞拉诺·多明格斯将军率领革命军击败了伊莎贝拉二世女王的政府军，后者由曼努埃尔·帕维亚将军指挥。伊莎贝拉二世因此离开西班牙，流亡法国。

en.s: The siege of Strasbourg took place during the Franco-Prussian War, and resulted in the French surrender of the fortress on 28 September 1870. After the German victory at Wörth, troops from the Grand Duchy of Baden under Prussian General August von Werder were detached to capture Strasbourg with the help of two Prussian Landwehr divisions which had been guarding the North Sea coast.

zh.s: 普法战争期间，德军围攻斯特拉斯堡，法国守军于1870年9月28日投降。德军在沃尔特战役中获胜后，普鲁士将军奥古斯特·冯·维尔德率领巴登大公国部队前往攻占斯特拉斯堡，并得到两个普鲁士后备军师协助。这两个师此前一直驻守北海海岸。

en.t: The Brazilian Parliament passes a law that frees all children thereafter born to slaves, and all government-owned slaves
en.s: The Rio Branco law (Portuguese: Lei Rio Branco), also known as the Law of Free Birth (Lei do Ventre Livre), named after its champion, prime minister José Paranhos, Viscount of Rio Branco, was passed by the General Assembly of the Empire of Brazil on 28 September 1871. It was intended to grant freedom to all newborn children of slaves, and slaves of the state or crown.

zh.t: 巴西议会通过《里约布兰科法》
zh.s: 1871年9月28日，巴西帝国议会通过《里约布兰科法》（Lei Rio Branco），也称《自由出生法》（Lei do Ventre Livre）。该法以推动者、首相里约布兰科子爵若泽·帕拉尼奥斯的名字命名，规定奴隶所生子女以及政府或王室拥有的奴隶获得自由。

en.t: Battle of the North Fork of the Red River
en.s: The Battle of North Fork or the Battle of the North Fork of the Red River occurred on September 28, 1872, near McClellan Creek in Gray County, Texas, United States. A monument on that spot marks the site of the battle between the Comanche Indians under Kai-Wotche and Mow-way and a detachment of cavalry and scouts under U.S. Army Colonel Ranald S. Mackenzie. There was an accusation that the battle was really an attempt "to make a massacre," as during the height of battle some noncombatants were wounded while mixed in with warriors.

zh.s: 北支流战役又称红河北支流战役，于1872年9月28日在美国德克萨斯州格雷县麦克莱伦溪附近发生。一座纪念碑标示了战场位置。交战双方是凯沃奇和莫韦率领的科曼奇战士，以及美国陆军兰纳德·S·麦肯齐上校指挥的一支骑兵和侦察兵分队。有人指责这场战斗实际上是试图“制造一场屠杀”，因为激战期间有一些非战斗人员混在战士中受伤。

en.s: The Battle of Palo Duro Canyon was a military confrontation and a significant United States victory during the Red River War. The battle occurred on September 28, 1874, when several U.S. Army companies under Ranald S. Mackenzie attacked a large encampment of Plains Indians in Palo Duro Canyon in the Texas Panhandle.

zh.s: 帕洛杜罗峡谷战役是红河战争中的一次交战，也是美国取得的重大胜利。1874年9月28日，兰纳德·麦肯齐率领数个美国陆军连队，袭击了得克萨斯州狭长地带帕洛杜罗峡谷内的一处大型平原印第安人营地。

en.t: 1892 Wyoming Seminary vs. Mansfield Normal football game
en.s: The 1892 Wyoming Seminary vs. Mansfield Normal football game, played September 28, 1892, was the first-ever American football game played at night. The game was played between Wyoming Seminary (a private college preparatory school located in the Wyoming Valley of Northeastern Pennsylvania) and Mansfield Normal School in Mansfield, Pennsylvania. During the time period, it was common for a college and high school to play each other in football—a practice that has long since been discontinued.

zh.t: 1892年怀俄明神学院对曼斯菲尔德师范学校橄榄球赛
zh.s: 1892年9月28日，怀俄明神学院与曼斯菲尔德师范学校举行的橄榄球赛，是史上第一场在夜间进行的美式橄榄球比赛。当时，大学和高中球队互相比赛很常见，如今这种做法早已不再延续。怀俄明神学院是一所位于宾夕法尼亚州东北部怀俄明谷的私立大学预科学校；曼斯菲尔德师范学校位于宾夕法尼亚州曼斯菲尔德。

en.s: The Balangiga massacre was an incident in which the residents of the town of Balangiga on the Philippines island of Samar conducted a surprise attack on an occupying unit of the US 9th Infantry, killing 54. It is also known as the Battle of Balangiga, Balangiga encounter, Balangiga incident, or Balangiga conflict. The incident occurred on September 28, 1901, over five months after the April 19 publication of a "Peace Manifesto" by Emilio Aguinaldo acknowledging and accepting the sovereignty of the United States throughout the Philippines.

zh.s: 1901年9月28日，菲律宾萨马岛巴兰吉加镇的居民突袭了占领当地的美国陆军第9步兵团一支部队，造成54名美军士兵死亡。这一事件也称巴兰吉加战役、巴兰吉加遭遇战、巴兰吉加事件或巴兰吉加冲突。事件发生在埃米利奥·阿吉纳尔多于4月19日发表“和平宣言”、承认并接受美国对整个菲律宾拥有主权五个多月后。

en.t: Philippine–American War: Filipino guerrillas kill more than forty American soldiers while losing 28 of their own
en.s: The Philippine–American War, known alternatively as the Filipino–American War, Philippine Insurrection, or Tagalog Insurgency, emerged in early 1899 following the United States' annexation of the former Spanish colony of the Philippine Islands under the terms of the December 1898 Treaty of Paris following the Spanish–American War. Philippine nationalists had proclaimed independence in June 1898 and constituted the First Philippine Republic in January 1899.

zh.t: 美菲战争：菲律宾游击队击毙四十多名美军，自身损失28人
zh.s: 美菲战争又称菲律宾—美国战争、菲律宾叛乱或他加禄叛乱。1898年美西战争后，美国依据同年12月《巴黎条约》吞并了原属西班牙的菲律宾群岛，随后于1899年初爆发这场战争。菲律宾民族主义者已于1898年6月宣布独立，并于1899年1月建立第一菲律宾共和国。

en.t: Corporal Frank S. Scott of the United States Army becomes the first enlisted man to die in an airplane crash
en.s: Frank S. Scott (2 December 1883 – 28 September 1912) was a United States Army corporal who died during his second enlistment, aged 28, in an aircraft crash. As the first enlisted American to die in an aircraft incident, Scott was memorialized multiple times.

zh.t: 美国陆军下士弗兰克·S·斯科特在空难中遇难，成为首位因飞机事故死亡的美国军方士兵
zh.s: 弗兰克·S·斯科特是美国陆军下士，1912年9月28日遇难，年仅28岁。当时他正服第二期兵役，是首位在飞机事故中死亡的美国军方士兵。后来，人们多次以他的名字纪念他。

en.t: Naval operations of the Kamerun campaign
en.s: The Naval operations of the Kamerun campaign were carried out by German and Allied forces during the Kamerun campaign of the First World War from August to September 1914. Naval activity occurred all along the coast of German Kamerun in the Bight of Bonny but most of the action took place in the Wouri estuary. The main event of the campaign were the successful British and French amphibious landings at Duala.

zh.t: 喀麦隆战役中的海军行动
zh.s: 第一次世界大战喀麦隆战役期间，德军和盟军于1914年8月至9月在喀麦隆沿海展开海军行动，活动范围遍及邦尼湾的德属喀麦隆海岸，主要集中在伍里河口。战役的主要行动是英法军队成功实施的杜阿拉两栖登陆。

en.s: The Battle of Es Sinn was a World War 1 military engagement between Anglo-Indian and Ottoman forces. It took place on 28 September 1915, during the Mesopotamian Campaign. The sides fought to determine control of the lower Tigres and Euphrates rivers, in what is now Iraq. The British and Indian governments also viewed it as a test of the Ottoman forces, and whether a further advance to capture Baghdad was possible. The Anglo-Indian forces of Indian Expeditionary Force D were under the command of Major-General Charles Vere Ferres Townshend, and the Ottoman forces by Colonel Nureddin.

zh.s: 埃斯辛战役是第一次世界大战美索不达米亚战役期间英印军与奥斯曼军队的一次交战，于1915年9月28日发生。双方争夺底格里斯河和幼发拉底河下游的控制权，战场位于今伊拉克境内。英国和印度政府也把这场战斗视为检验奥斯曼军力的机会，以判断能否继续推进并攻占巴格达。查尔斯·维尔·费雷斯·汤森少将指挥英印远征军D部队，努雷丁上校指挥奥斯曼军队。

en.s: The Battle of Morval, 25–28 September 1916, was an attack during the Battle of the Somme by the British Fourth Army on the villages of Morval, Gueudecourt and Lesbœufs held by the German 1st Army, which had been the final objectives of the Battle of Flers–Courcelette (15–22 September). en.s: Penicillins (P, PCN or PEN) are a group of β-lactam antibiotics originally obtained from Penicillium moulds, principally P. chrysogenum and P. rubens. en.t: Egyptian President Gamal Abdel Nasser dies of a heart attack in Cairo
en.s: Gamal Abdel Nasser Hussein (15 January 1918 – 28 September 1970) was an Egyptian military officer and revolutionary who served as the second president of Egypt from 1954 until his death in 1970. Following a 1954 assassination attempt by a Muslim Brotherhood member, he cracked down on the organization, put President Mohamed Naguib under house arrest and assumed executive office.

en.s: The Interim Agreement on the West Bank and the Gaza Strip, commonly known as Oslo II or Oslo 2, was a key and complex agreement in the Israeli–Palestinian peace process. Because it was signed in Taba, Egypt, it is sometimes called the Taba Agreement. The Oslo Accords envisioned the establishment of a Palestinian interim self-government in the Palestinian territories. Oslo II created the Areas A, B and C in the West Bank. The Palestinian Authority was given some limited powers and responsibilities in the Areas A and B and a prospect of negotiations on a final settlement based on Security Council Resolutions 242 and 338. The Accord was officially signed on 28 September 1995.

en.s: The 2008 Singapore Grand Prix, formally known as the 2008 Formula 1 SingTel Singapore Grand Prix, was a Formula One race held on 28 September 2008 at 20:00 SST at the newly built Marina Bay Street Circuit in Marina Bay, Singapore. en.t: Falcon 1 becomes the first privately developed liquid-fuel ground-launched vehicle to put a payload into orbit by the RatSat mission
en.s: Falcon 1 was a two-stage small-lift launch vehicle that was operated from 2006 to 2009 by SpaceX, an American aerospace manufacturer. On September 28, 2008, Falcon 1 became the first privately developed fully liquid-fueled launch vehicle to successfully reach orbit. The Falcon 1 used LOX/RP-1 for both stages, the first stage powered by a single pump-fed Merlin engine, and the second stage powered by SpaceX's pressure-fed Kestrel vacuum engine.

zh.s: 2008年9月28日，猎鹰1号通过“RatSat”任务将载荷送入轨道，成为首个由私人企业研发并成功进入轨道的全液体燃料运载火箭。猎鹰1号是SpaceX于2006年至2009年运营的两级小型运载火箭，两级均使用液氧和RP-1燃料；一级使用单台梅林发动机，二级使用压力供给式开斯特尔真空发动机。

en.s: Fighting between separatist forces affiliated with the Donetsk People's Republic (DPR), and Ukrainian military and volunteer forces broke out at Donetsk International Airport on 28 September 2014, sparking the Second Battle of Donetsk Airport, a part of the ongoing war in the Donbass region of Ukraine. en.s: An indirect election for the French Senate was held on Sunday 28 September 2014. Senators were primarily elected by municipal officials, and the number of seats is fixed at 348. en.t: Hurricane Ian makes landfall in Cayo Costa State Park, Florida as a category four hurricane, killing 169 and doing $113 billion in damage, becoming Florida's costliest hurricane and the deadliest in 89 years
en.s: Hurricane Ian was a large and catastrophic tropical cyclone that became the third costliest weather disaster on record worldwide. It was also the deadliest hurricane to strike the state of Florida since the 1935 Labor Day hurricane, and the strongest hurricane to make landfall in Florida since Michael in 2018. Ian caused widespread damage across western Cuba, Florida, and the Carolinas.
